array.string: vm=1xbts; vbox=/Volumes/ssd_array/virtualbox_machines/1xbts/1xbts.vbox; PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH i=0; while [ ! -f "$vbox" ] && [ $i -lt 60 ]; do sleep 5; i=$((i+1)); done [ -f "$vbox" ] || { echo "$(date): $vbox not found"; exit 1; } if VBoxManage showvminfo "$vm" --machinereadable | grep -q '^VMState="running"'; then echo "$(date): $vm already running" else echo "$(date): starting $vm"; VBoxManage startvm "$vm" --type headless fi
